name: swiftui-visual-design-research
description: Research visual direction, motion references, and reusable components for new or existing SwiftUI interfaces.

interface.shortDescription: Design research for new and existing SwiftUI interfaces.
interface.longDescription: Assess existing screens or plan an initial UI, compare visual and motion references, evaluate reusable SwiftUI components, and prepare a prioritized design brief.
interface.defaultPrompt: Research the visual direction for my SwiftUI app, whether its interface already exists or is being planned.
